notes: REF-BM-02: metadata-parser/fetcher collect only title and description; no favicon or preview image is fetched or stored. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable via PUT, but no note field exists in schema so note cannot be edited. REF-BM-06: duplicate url is blocked with a 409 and 'already saved' message (existingBookmarkId returned) but the client never opens/converges to editing the existing bookmark. REF-BM-07: card shows title/description/tags but the 'favicon' is a first-letter monogram, not a real favicon (no favicon stored). REF-BM-10: TagInput is a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url/tag-name but there is no note field to search. REF-BM-14: search is plain substring LIKE; '#tag' is not parsed as tag syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list is always ordered created_at DESC with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot and no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag; delete is permanent-only with no reversible archive or archive view. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter persistence. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
